description:
Whether you're commuting to class or trekking on narrow singletracks, experience it all with the Nishiki Men's Pagosa Sport Bike. Built with a durable aluminum frame, this bike cruises with stability. The reliable 700C wheels withstand terrain from rocky roads to smooth pavement, while the disc brakes deliver optimum stopping control.

Product Features

Lightweight 6061 aluminum frame with internal cables, double water bottle mounts, tapered head tube, rear rack mounts and replaceable derailleur hanger

Shimano EZ fire triggers provide simple up and down shifting at the press of a button

The reliable 700C wheels withstand terrain from rocky roads to smooth pavement, while the disc brakes deliver optimum stopping control

Nishiki Suspension fork with 80mm travel

Shimano Altus 11-32T, 3 x 8 speed drivetrain

Mechanical disc brakes provide reliable stopping power

Bike weighs approximately 33 lbs.

Lightweight double wall aluminum rims with 700 x 40mm multi-pavement tires

Hybrid bike capable of both path and pavement rides
